autovault.title: Auto Vault Settings
autovault.gui.tooltip.enabled: Enable or disable the auto-opener mod entirely
autovault.gui.tooltip.use_filter: Enable or disable filtering. If ON, vaults will only open if they contain selected presets or custom items.
autovault.gui.tooltip.wind_burst: Only open vaults for Enchanted Books that have the Wind Burst enchantment
autovault.gui.tooltip.custom_input: Enter Minecraft item ID, e.g., minecraft:diamond
autovault.gui.tooltip.add_remove_btn: Add or remove the specified item ID from the filter. Custom entries can also be deleted by clicking them in the list below.
autovault.gui.tooltip.clear_list: Remove all custom items from the filter list
autovault.gui.tooltip.reset: Reset all settings to default values
autovault.gui.tooltip.done: Save changes and return to the game
